info.title: API-DocTest-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Partners API allows users to access a comprehensive list of loyalty points partners associated with the hotel program. This endpoint serves as a resource for developers to retrieve valuable information about the partnerships available to enhance customer loyalty programs. Typical consumers include hotel chain applications and integrations looking to display or utilize loyalty rewards options. By leveraging this API, businesses can seamlessly provide their clients with updated and relevant partner offerings that drive engagement and enhance overall customer experience.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of partner points.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of partner points associated with the system. You can use this information to understand the partners available and their respective point details.
